svg.title: Attention shares; the FFN processes
svg.desc: A Transformer block alternates attention and a position-wise nonlinear feed-forward network, each with residual connections.

g.text: Attention mixes information between tokens; the position-wise FFN adds nonlinear processing.
A TRANSFORMER BLOCK ALTERNATES SHARING AND PROCESSING
residual: x + f(x) · identity path helps gradients
Attention moves information; FFN applies nonlinear processing.
